query: what is my favorite editor for Rust development

seed_memories.content: What is my favorite editor for Rust development: Neovim with rust-analyzer plus telescope.nvim. I keep a personal Lua config and prefer LSP-driven navigation over fuzzy file pickers for code search.
seed_memories.summary: Favorite editor for Rust development: Neovim plus rust-analyzer.
